name: Great Expectations
equipment: A copy of the book (public domain -- free from Project Gutenberg or Standard Ebooks)
instructions: Great Expectations was written by Charles Dickens, first published in 1861.
Pip, a poor orphan, receives a mysterious fortune and rises into gentility -- one of Dickens's most tightly plotted novels, built around a genuinely surprising reveal.
Discussion prompt: Social Ambition is one of the novel's central threads -- note a passage where you saw it most clearly.
Read at your own pace this week; use today's video as background before or after your reading session.
